Hi Lina —

Thanks for partnering with Redwood on the upcoming integration. To get vendor setup started on our side and ensure timely first payment, could you please provide the items below by end of week (EOW Friday)?

Required items:
- Legal entity full name as registered with tax authorities
- Registered business address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Tax identifier (EIN/Tax ID or foreign equivalent) and type
- Remit-to details: preferred payment method (ACH or wire), currency (USD), and remit name
- Bank details for ACH/wire (bank name, account name, account number, routing/ABA number or SWIFT/IBAN)
- W-9 or W-8BEN (if non-US) and a recent bank letter or voided check for ACH verification

Attachments I will upload on our side: vendor onboarding checklist (spreadsheet) and a redwood ACH authorization DocuSign link — please sign that if you elect ACH.

Process notes:
- Redwood typically issues a PO for new vendors; please confirm if Acme requires a PO number before invoicing.
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated (we can discuss).

If you prefer, you can reply with the remit.csv I requested and attach the W-9; I can ingest and route to Payables.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Lina — this is great. A few follow-ups so we can complete vendor provisioning without delays: 

1) Legal entity/address: please paste exact registered name and full address as it appears on the W-9 (street, city, state, ZIP). We use that for our tax records.
2) Tax ID confirmation: you listed EIN 12-3456789 — thanks, please confirm exact format for our intake.
3) Bank details: for ACH we require either a bank letter on bank letterhead or a scanned voided check. If you can attach the bank letter, that will expedite setup.
4) ACH fields we will store: account holder name, account number, routing (ABA) and bank name. Avoid sending account numbers in plaintext where possible; you can upload the bank letter or use the secure DocuSign link.
5) PO process: Redwood issues a PO for vendor services and goods; we can provide a PO number once vendor provisioning completes. If you need a PO before work starts, tell us and we'll prioritize a preliminary PO.

I've uploaded our onboarding checklist for Acme and a sample PO template to Confluence (link below). Priyom — once we have the bank letter and confirm EIN/address, I'll kick the vendor creation in our ERP and route to AP for payment terms.

Confluence (sample PO + checklist): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PROC/Vendor+Onboarding+Checklist
DocuSign ACH form (for signatures): https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?docId=abc123

Best,
